using CUDA
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
@inline function __stade_wa_xor(m::UInt32, u::UInt64, k::Int32)
        lo = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), k)
        hi = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), k)
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_lane1(m::UInt32, u::UInt64)
        lo = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), Int32(1))
        hi = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), Int32(1))
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float64)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(16)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(8)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(4)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(2)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(1)))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float32)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(16))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(8))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(4))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(2))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(1))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx, val)
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end


function k_plain!(loss, y, t, n)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i > n
        return nothing
    end
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += (y[i] - t[i]) ^ 2
    return nothing
end
function k_wa!(loss, y, t, n)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i > n
        return nothing
    end
    __stade_wa_add!(loss, 1, (y[i] - t[i]) ^ 2)
    return nothing
end
plain!(loss, y, t, n) = (@cuda threads = 256 blocks = max(1, cld(n, 256)) k_plain!(loss, y, t, n); nothing)
wa!(loss, y, t, n) = (@cuda threads = 256 blocks = max(1, cld(n, 256)) k_wa!(loss, y, t, n); nothing)
host_mr!(loss, y, t, n) = (CUDA.@allowscalar loss[1] = loss[1] + mapreduce((a, b) -> (b - a) ^ 2, +, view(t, 1:n), view(y, 1:n)); nothing)
dev_mr!(loss, y, t, n) = (tmp = mapreduce((a, b) -> (b - a) ^ 2, +, view(t, 1:n), view(y, 1:n); dims = 1); loss .+= tmp; nothing)
function timeit(f, loss, y, t, n; reps = 30)
    for _ in 1:3; fill!(loss, 0.0); f(loss, y, t, n); end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    for _ in 1:reps; fill!(loss, 0.0); f(loss, y, t, n); end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6 / reps
end
function graph_ok(f, loss, y, t, n)
    try
        fill!(loss, 0.0); f(loss, y, t, n); CUDA.synchronize()
        g = CUDA.capture() do
            f(loss, y, t, n)
        end
        ex = CUDA.instantiate(g)
        fill!(loss, 0.0); CUDA.launch(ex); CUDA.synchronize()
        return "ok " * string(Array(loss)[1])
    catch e
        return "ERR " * first(replace(sprint(showerror, e), r"\s+" => " "), 160)
    end
end
function main()
    out = String[]
    push!(out, "\"dev\": \"" * CUDA.name(CUDA.device()) * "\"")
    rows = String[]
    for n in (1000, 10000, 32768, 131072, 1000000, 4000000, 16000000)
        y = CUDA.rand(Float64, n); t = CUDA.rand(Float64, n); loss = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1)
        fill!(loss, 0.0); host_mr!(loss, y, t, n); ref = Array(loss)[1]
        for (nm, f) in (("host_mapreduce", host_mr!), ("atomic_plain", plain!), ("atomic_warp", wa!), ("dev_mapreduce", dev_mr!))
            try
                ms = timeit(f, loss, y, t, n)
                fill!(loss, 0.0); f(loss, y, t, n); CUDA.synchronize(); v = Array(loss)[1]
                gr = (nm == "host_mapreduce") ? "n/a (host sync)" : graph_ok(f, loss, y, t, n)
                push!(rows, "{\"n\": $n, \"method\": \"$nm\", \"ms\": $ms, \"relerr\": $(abs(v - ref) / abs(ref)), \"graph\": \"$(replace(gr, "\"" => "'"))\"}")
            catch e
                push!(rows, "{\"n\": $n, \"method\": \"$nm\", \"error\": \"" * replace(first(replace(sprint(showerror, e), r"\s+" => " "), 200), "\"" => "'") * "\"}")
            end
        end
        y = nothing; t = nothing; GC.gc(); CUDA.reclaim()
    end
    push!(out, "\"rows\": [" * join(rows, ",") * "]")
    println("{" * join(out, ",") * "}")
end
main()
